title: choose the dashboard's world
question: The roll assigned the rescue beacon. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Rescue beacon
options.lineage: avalanche transceivers and handheld SAR locators
options.thesis: The dashboard is the rescuer's handheld: an arrow and a distance that lead you to a buried person.
materials: reflective segment LCD with ghost segments
options.viewport: One instrument face: live camera in a window of the shell, a huge bearing arrow and distance to the nearest person, a segment mission clock, and a SEARCH / RETURN / SYNC mode slider.
options.risk: Tips into toy skeuomorphism if the shell gets bevels and gloss instead of flat molded color.

raised.raise: Every mission state is always on the screen as an unlit ghost segment; only the live one is struck dark.
The mission runs as fixed stations in order (deploy, search, return, sync), and survivor photos develop in when HQ syncs.
Nothing eases: readouts snap segment by segment, like a real LCD refreshing.

options.label: USAR spray marks
options.lineage: FEMA urban search-and-rescue structure and victim markings
options.thesis: Every survivor is marked the way USAR teams spray-paint a searched room: an X with time, team, and count.
options.viewport: The floor-plan map as a concrete slab with orange X-codes sprayed at each survivor; camera and controls stenciled at the edges.
options.risk: Hazard orange on concrete is where most rescue-themed designs land; familiar by nature.

options.label: Crisis command wall
options.thesis: The mission as an emergency on a wall: monumental countdowns, condition bars, alarms that invert the frame.
options.viewport: A black field with a giant blackout countdown, a hex-tiled map, and framed label blocks leading out from a robot silhouette.
options.case: Judges recognize it instantly and the countdown carries the blackout; loses on clarity and sits close to the dark-neon category default.
options.risk: Reads as cosplay if the chevrons and glow outrun the actual data.

options.label: Darkroom safelight
options.thesis: Survivor photos develop in the tray as the robot's data syncs.
options.viewport: Stations in order across the screen, prints emerging in the develop tray.
options.case: Responders and judges don't identify with a darkroom, and amber-on-amber hurts the live video.
options.risk: Everything is amber, so state color has nowhere to go.
options.kept: Ordered mission stations and the develop-in reveal on sync.

options.label: Cathode numerals
options.thesis: Every possible value hangs present as a ghost; the live one is struck forward.
options.viewport: Numeral stacks for clock, distance, and survivor count behind a mesh.
options.case: A lab curiosity to this audience, and the gauze fights the camera feed.
options.risk: Warm glow on blue-black is close to the neon-dashboard default.
options.kept: All states visible at once as ghosts, the live one struck.

options.label: Acetate manual
options.thesis: Each panel is an acetate leaf hinged over a colored divider board.
options.viewport: A tab rail of mission sections down the edge, content on leaves.
options.case: Nobody in a rescue scene reaches for a manual; it slows the live task.
options.risk: Turns a live console into reading.
options.kept: No easing anywhere: changes are hard two-frame steps.

options.label: Industrial quotes
options.thesis: Every zone labeled with its literal name in quotes, hazard stripes under what matters.
options.viewport: Stenciled label plates with 45-degree hazard bands.
options.case: Fashion irony undercuts a rescue story in front of judges.
options.risk: The quotes read as a joke about the product.
options.kept: Diagonal stripes reserved for blocked or disabled states only.

options.label: Alphabet storm
options.thesis: Words condense into weather across the screen.
options.viewport: Transcripts drifting as weather over a white field.
options.case: No link to rescue work and it obscures live state.
options.kept: One type voice does all display work.

canonCard.label: Mission control, played straight
canonCard.thesis: The dark robotics ops console, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Video left, map and survivor list right, status pills across the top.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other robotics dashboard at the expo.
